sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Random Ability Power from 90 to 190. Success value 65. 4x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 20 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Increases ATK and MATK by 30% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 50 seconds. (affects Archer Classes).
